description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelIcon class, which extends SugarWidgetField and provides methods to render icon links and images within subpanel layouts in the SuiteCRM framework. It handles display logic for module icons, attachments, and access control within the user interface.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelIcon
classes.description: A widget class that renders icons for subpanels in the SuiteCRM user interface, including handling permissions and attachments.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space for header cell display in subpanel layout.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates HTML for the icon image and link for a subpanel item, considering permissions, attachments, and dynamic images.
